helpScreen.title: Help
helpScreen.guideBody: Drawary lets you create the drawers you need, choose what each drawer stores, and add your items one by one.
helpScreen.guideStep1: Create a drawer — choose what you want to organize.
helpScreen.guideStep2: Set up sections — add the dates, amounts, text, or other details you need.
helpScreen.guideStep3: Fill the drawer — add and manage your stored items.
helpScreen.faqStorageA: Drawary stores its data on this device. It is not uploaded to a Drawary account or server.
helpScreen.faqBackupQ: How do I move my data to another device?
helpScreen.faqBackupA: Use Backup in Settings to save a file, then import it on the other device.
helpScreen.contactBody: If you have a question or run into a problem, send us an email.

infoScreen.title: About
infoScreen.tagline: A personal data app for creating your own drawers and organizing what matters to you
infoScreen.storageBody: Drawary stores its data on this device without a separate account or Drawary server.
